question: The Indian Armed Forces contingent participating in the multilateral joint military exercise ZAPAD 2025 is being led by which regiment of the Indian Army?
solution:
p data-end="57" data-start="0">The correct answer is __**Kumaon Regiment**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The **Indian Armed Forces** contingent for the **ZAPAD 2025** exercise is led by the **Kumaon Regiment** of the **Indian Army**. This regiment was selected due to its rich heritage and operational expertise in diverse terrains.
 
• **ZAPAD 2025** is a **multilateral joint military exercise** hosted by **Russia**. It brings together several nations to practice **counter-terrorism** strategies and enhance **multinational military cooperation**.
 
• The exercise focuses on the **interoperability** of different military wings, including **mechanized infantry**, **artillery**, and **air support**, to handle complex **security threats**. ***Hence, the correct option is Kumaon Regiment.***
 
• The **Indian Army** participation in **ZAPAD** typically involves a **battalion-strength** contingent. In the **2025** edition, the **Kumaon Regiment** represents the professional standards and **tactical proficiency** of the **Indian Infantry**.
